notablePrerequisites:
Ioreth and Vizier of Tumbling Sands do not have summoning sickness.
There is another legendary creature on the battlefield.
description:
If Vizier of Tumbling Sands is not your Ring-bearer, use the card that causes the Ring to tempt you to cause Vizier of Tumbling Sands to become your Ring-bearer, thus making it legendary.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands and another legendary creature.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Repeat from step 2.
